items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Smith sit; more targets to other Eagles WRs/TEs
items.opportunity: Potential boost for Dontayvion Wicks or Goedert

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.why: Hip/groin progress, full practice participation, coach McVay confirmation
items.implication: Start Nacua confidently in favorable matchup
items.opportunity: Restores high target/route share for Nacua; Adams may see slight dip

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle, missed practice all week
items.implication: Sit Jefferson; targets shift to Addison and others
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Jordan Addison

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears.
items.implication: Hall sit; Braelon Allen workhorse role expected
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for Jets RBs behind Hall

items.text: Commanders rule out Jayden Daniels; Marcus Mariota starts vs Colts.
items.why: Left elbow dislocation recovery, limited practice but not ready
items.implication: Sit Daniels; stream Mariota in good matchup
items.opportunity: Mariota start opportunity with rush upside

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
Nico Collins is good to go.
items.why: Texans Friday injury report clears him
items.opportunity: Full target share restored vs Cowboys

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% with Sampson healthy). Now on pace to catch 64 passes.
items.why: 4-game sample elevated target share and receiving pace without Sampson
items.implication: Judkins more valuable as pass-catching RB; hold/start in PPR

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top 10 play: led RBs with 90% snap rate, 20 of 22 RB touches last week with Dowdle out again. Cleveland allows 88+ rush yards every game.
items.why: Workhorse usage (90% snaps) + favorable matchup vs CLE

items.text: Drake London LOVE: 35% career target share/104 YPG with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite target share with Penix + favorable NO secondary

items.text: Omarion Hampton on Week 4 Hate List: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third downs. SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Poor usage metrics and tough SEA run defense

items.text: Garrett Wilson LOVE: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last time Mitchell sidelined. 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Elevated target share without Mitchell + soft CHI secondary

items.text: Josh Downs LOVE: 31% target share last two games, 43% red-zone looks. WSH allows most WR fantasy points and slot TDs.
items.why: Rising target/red-zone share + elite matchup vs WSH

items.text: Kyle Pitts HATE: Just 16% target share/34 YPG career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9 of 13 such games; TE37 utilization.
